newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 30.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
** On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 64.73 points at 5,647.65, its largest drop since July 15, after signs of a surprisingly strong U.S. economy boosted long-term bond

** Around 2,000 of Indonesia's controversial Timor national car made by Kia Motor Corp of South Korea arrived at Jakarta's Tanjung Priok port on Thursday. The cars will be jointly marketed by Kia and PT Timor Putra Nasional, controlled by a son of President Suharto, which plans next year to start assembling the vehicles in Indonesia.
** The Jakarta Composite Index, rose 1.60 points, or 0.29 percent, to close at 550.03 points on Thursday led by fresh-buying on selected big-capitalised stocks.
** On Friday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,342.80/43.35 in early trading against an opening of 2,342.20/42.80.
